question: Which identity_cost.kind fits a sign-up that accepts only a third-party OAuth account (GitHub or Google) and publishes no email-and-password form, as Ownkube does? The seven terms have no value for it; the record keeps `email` and says the gate is a GitHub or Google account in `detail`.
why: the kind `email` is the nearest term but names a credential the sign-up does not offer; the true gate is an account at another provider
